comment: Metric catalogue. 'browser.<id>' inherits the spec of '<id>' unless listed explicitly. gate = stats compared against the baseline; report = extra stats shown but never gated. slack = absolute change below which a regression is ignored (default by unit). pct = relative threshold override (default 5). noiseWidening=false disables max(5%, 2*CV) widening. budgets: absolute limits (value must be < max); a breach fails only if the baseline met it. A budget with warn:true is reported but never fails. memory.leak.* exist only in --leak runs; memory.typical.* and typical.* only in --typical runs.

startup.main-start.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:main-start mark, ms since navigation start

startup.settings-ready.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:settings-ready mark, ms since navigation start

startup.theme-applied.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:theme-applied mark, ms since navigation start

startup.app-module-ready.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:app-module-ready mark, ms since navigation start

startup.render-called.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:render-called mark, ms since navigation start

startup.first-frame.desc: report-only: vaultdraw:boot:first-frame mark, ms since navigation start

vault.openToTree.desc: Open Vault Folder click to root tree rows painted

vault.searchIndexReady.desc: open click to needle query returning 1 result

tree.expandBigFolder.desc: expand the 500-drawing folder to rows painted

search.keystroke.desc: per keystroke, input to results painted

budgets.why: DECISIONS: search p95 < 50 ms on a 5,000-drawing vault

open.small.desc: click to the editor ready and two painted frames. Packaged low-end: report-only (D9), gated on open.small.ready and Chromium x4.

open.medium.desc: click to the editor ready and two painted frames. Packaged low-end: report-only (D9), gated on open.medium.ready and Chromium x4.

open.large.desc: No absolute budget by decision: the large drawing embeds ~18 MB of images, so only the 5% regression gate applies. Packaged low-end: report-only (D9), gated on open.large.ready and Chromium x4.

open.small.ready.desc: click to the editor ready with the new scene committed (open.small without the two painted frames). Gates low-end open (D9): under background QoS each painted frame waits ~107 ms (frame.rafInterval), this does not.

open.medium.ready.desc: open.medium without the two painted frames; gates low-end open (D9)

open.large.ready.desc: open.large without the two painted frames; gates low-end open (D9). No absolute budget, like open.large.

switch.drawing.desc: drawing A open, click drawing B (small<->medium alternating) in the navigator to B's canvas painted

switch.recent.desc: as switch.drawing, for the A-B-A switch back to a recently opened drawing

settings.close.desc: Escape to settings closed and painted

palette.openFiles.desc: Cmd+P to palette rows painted (files mode)

palette.openCommands.desc: Cmd+Shift+P to palette rows painted (commands mode)

frame.rafInterval.desc: interval between back-to-back requestAnimationFrame callbacks with no DOM work (frame pacing floor; ~8 at 120 Hz, ~100 under macOS background QoS)

search.keystrokeJs.desc: per keystroke, JS cost of the input event (dispatch to return, no frame wait)

typing.keystrokeJs.desc: per character in the WYSIWYG editor, JS cost of the input event (dispatch to return)

zoom.fps.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames per second while pinch-zooming (native magnify into the WKWebView, 120 events/s; one sample per drawing). 120 Hz screens only

budgets.why: 120 Hz ProMotion: every pattern must stay >= 110 fps

pan.fps.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames per second while two-finger panning (native trackpad scroll, 120 events/s)

budgets.why: 120 Hz ProMotion: every pattern must stay >= 110 fps

zoom.renderHz.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames per second that showed a new static-canvas render while zooming (what the eye sees)

budgets.why: drawn Hz also carries the timing of the injected input (~118 events/s, not vsync-locked): frames without input have nothing new to draw, so this is a warning; zoom.missedInputHz is the gate

zoom.missedInputHz.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames/s that received input but showed no new static render while zooming (inputFrameHz - renderHz)

budgets.why: every frame that got input is drawn (2 Hz slack for pass edges)

pan.renderHz.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames per second that showed a new static-canvas render while panning

budgets.why: drawn Hz also carries the timing of the injected input (~118 events/s, not vsync-locked): frames without input have nothing new to draw, so this is a warning; pan.missedInputHz is the gate

pan.missedInputHz.desc: refresh-rate probe: frames/s that received input but showed no new static render while panning (inputFrameHz - renderHz)

budgets.why: every frame that got input is drawn (2 Hz slack for pass edges)

zoom.framesLe9msPct.desc: refresh-rate probe: share of frame intervals <= 9 ms while zooming

pan.framesLe9msPct.desc: refresh-rate probe: share of frame intervals <= 9 ms while panning

pan.longFrames.desc: frames > 50 ms; no new long tasks: median must not exceed baseline

typing.longFrames.desc: frames > 50 ms; no new long tasks: median must not exceed baseline

typing.keystroke.desc: per character typed, input to next frame

idle.cpuPercent.desc: CPU of app + WebKit helpers over the idle window, % of one core

memory.peakRssMB.desc: peak sum of RSS (app + WebKit helpers); overcounts shared/framework pages, see memory.peakFootprintMB

memory.peakFootprintMB.desc: sum of lifetime phys_footprint_peak over app + WebKit helpers (Activity Monitor basis), read at idle-end

budgets.why: DECISIONS: peak memory < 400 MB with a large vault

memory.idleFootprintMB.desc: sum of current phys_footprint over app + WebKit helpers at idle-end

memory.leak.growthMB.desc: leak mode: total phys_footprint at idle-after minus baseline-before-loop (50 drawings opened, vault switched away and back)

budgets.why: leak scenario: footprint retained after opening 50 drawings; warning only until trusted

memory.leak.growthMB.app.desc: leak mode: app process growth (jsHeap: Chromium mode, after forced GC)

memory.leak.growthMB.webContent.desc: leak mode: webContent process growth (jsHeap: Chromium mode, after forced GC)

memory.leak.growthMB.gpu.desc: leak mode: gpu process growth (jsHeap: Chromium mode, after forced GC)

memory.leak.growthMB.network.desc: leak mode: network process growth (jsHeap: Chromium mode, after forced GC)

memory.leak.growthMB.jsHeap.desc: leak mode: jsHeap process growth (jsHeap: Chromium mode, after forced GC)

memory.leak.perTenDrawingsMB.desc: leak mode: least-squares footprint growth per 10 drawings opened (baseline and after-10..50)

memory.leak.pass2PerTenDrawingsMB.desc: leak mode: footprint slope per 10 drawings in the second pass over the same 50 drawings; ~0 = plateau, positive = steady growth

memory.leak.pass2GrowthMB.desc: leak mode: footprint at the end of pass 2 minus end of pass 1 (same drawings); ~0 = plateau

memory.leak.switchDeltaMB.desc: leak mode: after-vault-switch minus after the last drawing; negative = memory given back. Report only.

typical.vaultOpenToTree.desc: typical vault: Open Vault Folder click to root rows painted

typical.open.300.desc: typical vault: open the 300-element drawing with 2 images

typical.save.300.desc: typical vault: explicit save of the 300-element drawing

typical.pan.frame.desc: typical vault: frame interval while panning the 300-element drawing

memory.typical.idleFootprintMB.desc: typical vault: sum of phys_footprint (app + WebContent + GPU + network) at idle-end, to compare with other note apps

memory.typical.idle.appMB.desc: typical vault: app process footprint at idle-end

memory.typical.idle.webContentMB.desc: typical vault: webContent process footprint at idle-end

memory.typical.idle.gpuMB.desc: typical vault: gpu process footprint at idle-end

memory.typical.idle.networkMB.desc: typical vault: network process footprint at idle-end

browser.cpu.task.desc: CDP delta over one page run, TaskDuration: main-thread task time (wall time of tasks, so it still moves with load)

browser.cpu.script.desc: CDP delta over one page run, ScriptDuration: JS execution time (wall time)

browser.cpu.layout.desc: CDP delta over one page run, LayoutDuration: layout time (wall time)

browser.cpu.recalcStyle.desc: CDP delta over one page run, RecalcStyleDuration: style recalculation time (wall time)

browser.cpu.v8Compile.desc: CDP delta over one page run, V8CompileDuration: V8 compile time (0 with cached code)

browser.cpu.thread.desc: load-insensitive CDP delta over one page run, ThreadTime: CPU time of the renderer main thread (real CPU, not wall)

browser.cpu.process.desc: load-insensitive CDP delta over one page run, ProcessTime: CPU time of the whole renderer process (real CPU, not wall)

browser.count.layout.desc: CDP LayoutCount delta over one page run (deterministic, load-independent)

browser.count.recalcStyle.desc: CDP RecalcStyleCount delta over one page run (deterministic, load-independent)
